Wg.bar_b_note: The naturalistic boar has believable fur bulk, but a single flat ochre value with no face or eye read and only trainer height sits below the Palworld creature finish.

Oc.bar_b_note: Same boar as Wg: decent fur mass, but monotone ochre, a lost face at small size and a swim frame where it hangs over the water keep it short of shipping finish.

Kr.bar_b_note: A warm, expressive grandpa with clear eyes, a natural olive and cream palette and a clean silhouette matches the key art's day-panel characters and a shipping finish.

Dj.bar_b_note: The coyote model is close to the owner's style bar, with a lean, readable silhouette taller than the trainer, but the swim frame has it standing stiff-legged on the water surface, which breaks the finish.

Pw.bar_b_note: Same coyote as Dj: a strong naturalistic model and clear hurt and faint reads, held back by a swim pose that walks on the water and a low-contrast tan with little rim separation.

Pb.bar_b_note: Side B's larger, unclipped text and iconed Craft/Leave hints are serviceable, but the bare panel lacks Palworld's HUD polish, gives the craft action no teal emphasis and uses keyboard glyphs.

Ub.bar_b_note: A dark, muddy brown forest floor with no purple storm sky, lightning or copper and glass highlights, flat magenta ground rings for telegraphs, a near-invisible player creature, a heavy HUD and (on A) camera-in-canopy blackouts sink it.

Oz.bar_b_note: A's noisy black-gold mottling turns the coils into an unreadable tangle, and B's bold banded serpent faints by rising into a floating S-curve far above its own shadow.

top_changes.change: Stormwood fights: keep the camera out of trunks and canopy, swap the flat magenta ring and slab telegraphs for real-object effects (lightning, stones, dust impacts), and lift the fight's light with the purple storm sky, rim light on both fighters and a lighter HUD so the player's creature reads
Rework the serpent (Oz): ground its hurt and faint poses on the floor with contact shadows, and give it one clean, bold band pattern with a clear head, face and eyes instead of noisy mottling

Creature material and scale pass: break the boar's monotone ochre with darker mane, snout and leg values plus rim light and a visible eye, make every creature clearly taller than the 1.80 m trainer, and fix the swim frames (submerged body, no hovering or water-walking, no white water-plane edge)
